text:
adai: hey all, Ada here — second day. I can log into Console but the Flags -> Rollouts button is greyed out (403). Who approves staging rollout permission?

frank: welcome! :wave: staging rollouts are gated by the 'flag-deployer' role which infra grants via Okta group redwood-console-staging-deployers. Open the access form and tag your manager.

adai: filed the form but wondering if there's an emergency fast-path. I'm trying to unblock a hotfix for a flaky regen endpoint in staging.

nina_ops: we do an emergency grant if it's a legit incident and manager + oncall sign off. For day-0 dev access we usually grant deployer for 3 days. If it's an incident, ping #incidents and @oncall and include the ticket.

secrets-bot: Access request ACC-6221 created. Approvers needed: manager + infra. Auto-approvals disabled for deployer role in prod.

adai: ok noted. also need a scoped service token for CI to run a rollout test against staging. How do we store the token safely?

frank: good call. We create an SA and put the key into Vault at secret/onboarding/sa/adai-rollout. You get read access for 7 days. For CI use the Vault token ref in the pipeline.

devex: quick checklist to add to onboarding docs: 1) enable 2FA, 2) file Console access form, 3) request SA with tag "rollout-ci", 4) reference runbook. Example commands to include:

```
# authenticate via Vault
vault read -field=value secret/onboarding/sa/adai-rollout > /tmp/sa.json
ffctl auth login --service-account=/tmp/sa.json
ffctl rollouts start --env=staging --flag=my_feature --strategy=gradual
```

nina_ops: manual group add queued by frank. Should be done in ~10m. If you still see 403 after that, do a logout/login and clear site cache.

secrets-bot: Manual grant completed by frank. Group added: redwood-console-staging-deployers.

adai: I can access Rollouts now  and the SA is in Vault. One more Q: how often do temporary creds expire and how to rotate them?

frank: SA keys expire in 7 days by default. Use `vault renew secret/onboarding/sa/adai-rollout` or request extension on the access ticket. For longer-term CI, ask for a CI-scoped service account with longer TTL and additional approvals.

adai: perfect. I'll add a tiny how-to to docs and link the runbook. PR: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/123. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
